title: tiktok
description: Unofficial TikTok API & scraper: creator analytics, video data, comments, search. x402, no API key.
summary: Unofficial TikTok API & scraper: creator analytics, video data, comments, search. x402, no API key.
offersHint: Unofficial TikTok API & scraper: creator analytics, video data, comments, search. x402, no API key. · Remote MCP (streamable-http) at https://mcp.scraptik.com/mcp

toolsPreview.name: tiktok_creator_profile
toolsPreview.description: Fetch a TikTok creator's public profile: follower/following counts, total videos and likes, verification status, bio, region, and avatar. Use for influencer discovery, creator analytics, and audience-size vetting for UGC/brand deals. `handle` accepts an @username (e.g. `@charlidamelio`) or a numeric user_id.

toolsPreview.name: tiktok_resolve_username
toolsPreview.description: Resolve a TikTok @username to its stable numeric user_id and sec_uid. Cheap utility — call this first when you only have a handle and need an id for other tools.

toolsPreview.name: tiktok_creator_followers
toolsPreview.description: List a creator's followers (paginated). Use for audience mapping and finding connected accounts. Paginate with `cursor`.

toolsPreview.name: tiktok_creator_following
toolsPreview.description: List the accounts a creator follows (paginated). Use for interest-graph and collaboration analysis. Paginate with `cursor`.

toolsPreview.name: tiktok_creator_videos
toolsPreview.description: List a creator's recent videos with per-video stats (views, likes, comments, shares). Use to compute engagement rate, spot recent virality, or pull a content sample. Paginate with `cursor` (the `max_cursor` from the response). `user_id` accepts an @username or numeric id.

toolsPreview.name: tiktok_creator_liked_videos
toolsPreview.description: List videos a creator has publicly liked (only available when the account exposes its Likes tab). Use for taste/affinity analysis. Paginate with `cursor`.

toolsPreview.name: tiktok_user_stories
toolsPreview.description: List a creator's active TikTok Stories (ephemeral posts that expire ~24h). Use to capture story content before it disappears. `user_id` accepts an @username or numeric id.

toolsPreview.name: tiktok_video_stats
toolsPreview.description: Fetch a single TikTok video's stats and metadata: play/like/comment/share/save counts, author, sound, duration, description, hashtags, and create time. Use to measure a specific post's performance. Accepts a numeric `video_id` (aweme_id) or a full TikTok video URL.

toolsPreview.name: tiktok_video_comments
toolsPreview.description: List top-level comments on a video, most-relevant first, with like counts and authors. Use for sentiment sampling and audience-response analysis. Paginate with `cursor`.

toolsPreview.name: tiktok_comment_replies
toolsPreview.description: List replies to a specific comment on a video. Use to drill into a comment thread. Requires both `comment_id` and the parent `video_id`. Paginate with `cursor`.

toolsPreview.name: tiktok_video_download_url
toolsPreview.description: Resolve a watermark-free download URL for a TikTok video. Use to obtain the clean MP4 for archival or analysis. Accepts a numeric `video_id` or a full TikTok video URL.

toolsPreview.name: tiktok_sound_info
toolsPreview.description: Fetch metadata for a sound/track: title, author, duration, and how many videos use it. Use to size a sound's reach before pulling its videos.

toolsPreview.name: tiktok_sound_videos
toolsPreview.description: List videos that use a given sound/track, most-recent first. Use for sound-trend analysis, finding UGC around a track, or gauging a sound's virality. Paginate with `cursor`.

toolsPreview.name: tiktok_hashtag_videos
toolsPreview.description: List videos under a hashtag/challenge. Pass a resolved numeric `cid`, or a `hashtag` name (e.g. `booktok`) which is resolved to a cid first. Use for trend tracking and campaign monitoring. Passing `cid` directly skips the resolution lookup and is slightly faster.

toolsPreview.name: tiktok_search_videos
toolsPreview.description: Search TikTok videos by keyword, returning matching posts with stats. Use for topic/trend discovery and competitive research. Paginate with `cursor`.

toolsPreview.name: tiktok_search_creators
toolsPreview.description: Search TikTok creators by keyword/name, returning matching profiles. Use for influencer discovery and account lookup. Paginate with `cursor`.

toolsPreview.name: tiktok_search_hashtags
toolsPreview.description: Search TikTok hashtags/challenges by keyword, returning matching challenges with their cid and video counts. Use to find the right hashtag before pulling its videos. Paginate with `cursor`.

toolsPreview.name: tiktok_search_sounds
toolsPreview.description: Search TikTok sounds/tracks by keyword, returning matching music with usage counts. Use for audio/trend discovery. Paginate with `cursor`.

toolsPreview.name: tiktok_search_lives
toolsPreview.description: Search live TikTok streams by keyword. Use for real-time/live-content discovery. Paginate with `cursor`.
